method: Each process discards 3 warmups and measures 15 fresh documents per fixture. Modes 0=no hooks, 1=root paint tree hook only, 2=nested category hooks, 3=category hooks plus selected inherited object getters. Run order 0,1,2,3,2,1,0. Mode 1 provides least-instrumented phase estimates. Mode 2 categories are exclusive only with respect to the listed hooked methods, so mask preparation includes unhooked subtree work, filter drawing includes unhooked source rasterization and synchronization, and other includes unhooked work and hook overhead. Category means are additive; separate medians need not sum. Mode 3 introduces substantial overhead and is primarily useful for call counts. These are elapsed main-thread timings, not GPU kernel timings. Paint factory excludes direct allocations outside +paint. XML reading and bitmap creation/clearing excluded. No production instrumentation.

reproduction.compile: xcrun clang -O2 -fobjc-arc /tmp/ijsvg-phase-profile.m -F FRAMEWORK_PARENT -framework IJSVG -framework AppKit -framework QuartzCore -framework Metal -Wl,-rpath,FRAMEWORK_PARENT -o /tmp/ijsvg-phase-profile
reproduction.fixturesFormat: JSON array of objects with id and svg string; same as benchmark-first-render.py

categoryLimitations.bounds: Only calculateBoundingBoxForChildren and calculateFrameForChildren; CGPath bounds and other bounds work remain in other or their enclosing category.
categoryLimitations.gradient_preparation: Only drawableBasicGradientPaintForPaint:gradient:; direct-fill gradient font/unit preparation is unhooked and remains in other. CGGradient creation is separately measured during drawing.
categoryLimitations.mask_preparation: Includes unhooked mask subtree construction; not a standalone mask algorithm cost.
categoryLimitations.filter_drawing: Includes unhooked source rasterization, graph setup, filter work and waits; excludes separately hooked gradient/shape drawing. Not GPU kernel timing.
